questions.passage: To be clear, specialization and professionalism are great for skill acquisition and improvement. But remember the fate of Jack (played by Jack Nicholson) in Stanley Kubrick’s movie The Shining: all work and no play not only make Jack a dull boy, but also make him go nuts at the end. When winning becomes everything, life gets too heavy. A playful mindset can help people who are psychologically stuck move past their low points and enjoy the journey, not just the outcome.
questions.prompt: Which balance does the author advocate in this passage?
options: Reject skill development because professionalism has no value.
Value specialisation while using playfulness to enjoy the journey beyond winning alone.
Treat the fictional film as experimental proof about every professional.
Measure a life only by whether it wins every competition.
questions.promptZh: 本段作者主张什么平衡？
optionsZh: 专业化没有价值，因此拒绝技能发展。
肯定专攻的价值，同时用玩心享受过程，不只盯获胜。
把虚构电影当作关于所有专业人士的实验证明。
只用能否赢每次比赛衡量人生。
analyses: A 首句明确肯定技能习得与提高。
B 肯定 specialization 后转向 all winning 的沉重，再用 journey, not just outcome 提出平衡。
C Jack 是 The Shining 的电影角色，不能当临床或因果实验结论。
D winning becomes everything 正是作者所质疑的状态。can help 不等于对所有心理困难的治疗保证。

enjoy the journey, not just the outcome.

questions.passage: A spontaneous action could help us experience life without prior planning. Some of the most interesting experiences we have are often things we do on a whim. In my case, I was driving my family from Baltimore to Charlottesville one day when I saw a sign for Annapolis. I asked my wife and two kids, “Does anyone want to go to Annapolis?”
questions.prompt: What prompted the author to suggest visiting Annapolis?
options: Seeing a road sign while driving his family between two other cities.
A previously booked cruise that required an Annapolis stop.
A formal invitation received before leaving Baltimore.
A plan to move his family permanently to Annapolis.
questions.promptZh: 什么促使作者提议去 Annapolis？
optionsZh: 开车带家人往另两城途中，看到一块路牌。
早已预订的游船要求停靠 Annapolis。
离开 Baltimore 前收到正式邀请。
计划把全家永久搬到 Annapolis。
analyses: A driving...when I saw a sign 给出临时起意的触发。
B 本片段没有预订游船的安排。
C 没有正式邀请，作者是看到路牌后询问家人。
D 去游玩不等于永久迁居。could、often 也不能变成所有临时行动必有丰富结果。

evidence.quote: I was driving my family from Baltimore to Charlottesville one day when I saw a sign for Annapolis.

vocabulary.context: 与 without prior planning 相连，描述未提前安排的经历
vocabulary.example: On a whim, they visited a small museum on the way home.

questions.passage: To my surprise, everyone said, “Why not!” So we went to Annapolis, totally unplanned. We wandered around town and hopped on a cruise that my son still talks about.
questions.prompt: Which sequence is described after the family’s reply?
options: They rejected the suggestion and drove straight home.
They moved to Annapolis and gave up travelling.
They visited without planning, wandered around and took a cruise.
They cancelled a cruise that had been booked months earlier.
questions.promptZh: 家人回答后，发生了哪一顺序？
optionsZh: 他们拒绝建议，直接回家。
搬到 Annapolis 后放弃旅行。
未经计划前往、在城里闲逛，又乘游船。
取消几个月前订好的游船。
analyses: A everyone said Why not 是接受，非拒绝。
B went to 不等于迁居。
C totally unplanned、wandered、hopped on a cruise 依次对应。
D 原文说实际乘船，没给提前订票或取消的信息；儿子仍提起此事是个人记忆叙事，不是对所有家庭的实验。
